1 # 1 Pe 1.1 Yakobo, Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo akoa, kyea mmusuakuo dummienu a wɔahweteɛ no.
Gyidie ne nyansa
2 # Rom 5.3-5 Me nuanom, sɛ mohwe sɔhwɛ ahodoɔ bebree mu a, mommu no anigyeɛ koraa, 3na monhunu sɛ mo gyidie no sɔhwɛ yɛ boasetɔ ho adwuma. 4Na momma boasetɔ no nwie n’adwumayɛ pɛ, na moayɛ pɛ a ɛnkaa mo biribiara ara.
Nyansa a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn
5 # Mmb 2.3-6 Na sɛ ɛka mo mu bi nyansa a, ma no mmisa Onyankopɔn a ɔma nnipa nyinaa adeɛ kwa na ahohora nni mu no, na wɔde bɛma no. 6#Mar 11.24 Na gyidie mu na ma no mmisa, na ɔnnnye biribiara ho kyim, ɛfiri sɛ deɛ ɔgye kyim no te sɛ ɛpo asorɔkyeɛ a mframa rebɔ de no redi akɔneaba. 7Na mma saa onipa no nnsusu sɛ ɔbɛnya Awurade hɔ biribiara. 8Ɛfiri sɛ, onipa a n’adwene yɛ no ntanta no hinhim n’akwan nyinaa mu.
Ohia ne ahonya
9 # Yak 2.5 Na ma onua a wɔabrɛ aseɛ nhoahoa ne ho, sɛ wɔrema ne soɔ no mu, 10#1 Pe 1.24 na ɔdefoɔ nso deɛ, sɛ wɔrebrɛ no aseɛ no mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɛsene akɔ sɛ wiram nhwiren. 11#Yes 40.6-7 Na owia de ne hyehyeɛ firi, na ɛhye wira no a, na ne nhwiren apo, na n’ahoɔfɛ asɛe; saa ara na ɔdefoɔ nso bɛkusa wɔ n’akwan soɔ.
Nsɔhwɛ
12 # 2 Ti 4.8 Nhyira ne onipa a ɔto ne bo ase wɔ sɔhwɛ mu. Na sɛ ɔnya firi mu fi tɔtorɔtɔɔ a, ɔbɛnya nkwa abotire a Awurade de ahyɛ wɔn a wɔdɔ no no bɔ.
13Sɛ wɔsɔ obi hwɛ a, mma no nnka sɛ: Onyankopɔn na ɔsɔ me hwɛ. Ɛfiri sɛ bɔne bi nsɔ Onyankopɔn nhwɛ, na ɔno nso nsɔ obiara nhwɛ. 14#Rom 7.7-8 Na wɔsɔ obiara hwɛ a, na ɛyɛ ɔno ara n’akɔnnɔ, a ɛgyegye na ɛdaadaa no na ɛsɔ no hwɛ; 15#Rom 7.10 na akɔnnɔ no nyinsɛn a, ɛwo bɔne, na bɔne no wie nyini a, ɛwo owuo. 16Me nuanom adɔfo, mommma wɔnnnaadaa mo.
17 # 1 Yoh 1.5 Akyɛdeɛ pa nyinaa ne akyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ pɛ nyinaa firi soro, ɛfiri hann Agya no nkyɛn na ɛba. Ɔno na nsakyeraeɛ ne adaneadane sunsum nni ne mu. 18#Yoh 1.13; 1 Pe 1.23 Ɔnam ɔno ara ne pɛ so na ɔde ne nokwasɛm woo yɛn, sɛ yɛnyɛ n’abɔdeɛ no mu adekan bi.
Ɔsetie mu nhyira
19 # Ɔsɛ 7.9 Me nuanom adɔfo, monhunu yei sɛ: Nnipa nyinaa nyɛ ntɛm ntie, nyɛ nyaa nkasa, na wɔnyɛ nyaa mfa abufuo; 20#Efe 4.26 ɛfiri sɛ onipa abufuo nyɛ Nyankopɔn tenenee mu adeɛ. 21#Kol 3.8; 1 Pe 2.1 Enti monyi efi ne bɔne nyinaa nto ntwene, na momfa ɔdwoɔ nnye asɛm a wɔatɛ no mo mu a ɛbɛtumi agye mo kra no.
22 # Mat 7.26; Rom 2.13 Na monyɛ asɛm no yɛfoɔ, na monnyɛ atiefoɔ nko ara nnaadaa mo ho. 23Na sɛ obi yɛ asɛm no tiefoɔ na ɔnyɛ ɔyɛfoɔ a, ɔte sɛ onipa a ɔhwɛ n’anim suban ahwehwɛ mu. 24Na ɔhwɛ ne ho na ɔkɔ, na ntɛm ara na ne werɛ afiri su ko a ɔkura. 25#Yak 2.12; Rom 8.2; Yoh 13.17 Na deɛ ɔkoto hwɛ adehyedie mmara a ɛdi mu no mu, na ɔtena mu, na ɔnyɛ otiefoɔ werɛfirifoɔ, na mmom ɔyɛ adwuma no yɛfoɔ no, onii no na wɔbɛhyira no n’adeyɛ no mu.
26 # Dwom 34.13 Sɛ obi susu sɛ ɔyɛ onyamesomni, na wanto ne tɛkyerɛma nnareka, na mmom ɔdaadaa n’akoma a, saa onipa yi nyamesom yɛ ɔkwa. 27Onyamesom a ɛho teɛ na ɛho nni fi wɔ Agya Nyankopɔn anim ne sɛ obi kɔhwɛ nnyanka ne akunafoɔ wɔ wɔn ahohiahia mu, na ɔyi ne ho firi wiase nkekaeɛ mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Yakobo, Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo akoa, kyea mmusuakuo dummienu a wɔahweteɛ no.

Me nuanom, sɛ mohwe sɔhwɛ ahodoɔ bebree mu a, mommu no anigyeɛ koraa, na monhunu sɛ mo gyidie no sɔhwɛ yɛ boasetɔ ho adwuma. Na momma boasetɔ no nwie n’adwumayɛ pɛ, na moayɛ pɛ a ɛnkaa mo biribiara ara.

Na sɛ ɛka mo mu bi nyansa a, ma no mmisa Onyankopɔn a ɔma nnipa nyinaa adeɛ kwa na ahohora nni mu no, na wɔde bɛma no. Na gyidie mu na ma no mmisa, na ɔnnnye biribiara ho kyim, ɛfiri sɛ deɛ ɔgye kyim no te sɛ ɛpo asorɔkyeɛ a mframa rebɔ de no redi akɔneaba. Na mma saa onipa no nnsusu sɛ ɔbɛnya Awurade hɔ biribiara. Ɛfiri sɛ, onipa a n’adwene yɛ no ntanta no hinhim n’akwan nyinaa mu.

Na ma onua a wɔabrɛ aseɛ nhoahoa ne ho, sɛ wɔrema ne soɔ no mu, na ɔdefoɔ nso deɛ, sɛ wɔrebrɛ no aseɛ no mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɛsene akɔ sɛ wiram nhwiren. Na owia de ne hyehyeɛ firi, na ɛhye wira no a, na ne nhwiren apo, na n’ahoɔfɛ asɛe; saa ara na ɔdefoɔ nso bɛkusa wɔ n’akwan soɔ.

Nhyira ne onipa a ɔto ne bo ase wɔ sɔhwɛ mu. Na sɛ ɔnya firi mu fi tɔtorɔtɔɔ a, ɔbɛnya nkwa abotire a Awurade de ahyɛ wɔn a wɔdɔ no no bɔ.
Sɛ wɔsɔ obi hwɛ a, mma no nnka sɛ: Onyankopɔn na ɔsɔ me hwɛ. Ɛfiri sɛ bɔne bi nsɔ Onyankopɔn nhwɛ, na ɔno nso nsɔ obiara nhwɛ. Na wɔsɔ obiara hwɛ a, na ɛyɛ ɔno ara n’akɔnnɔ, a ɛgyegye na ɛdaadaa no na ɛsɔ no hwɛ; na akɔnnɔ no nyinsɛn a, ɛwo bɔne, na bɔne no wie nyini a, ɛwo owuo. Me nuanom adɔfo, mommma wɔnnnaadaa mo.
Akyɛdeɛ pa nyinaa ne akyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ pɛ nyinaa firi soro, ɛfiri hann Agya no nkyɛn na ɛba. Ɔno na nsakyeraeɛ ne adaneadane sunsum nni ne mu. Ɔnam ɔno ara ne pɛ so na ɔde ne nokwasɛm woo yɛn, sɛ yɛnyɛ n’abɔdeɛ no mu adekan bi.

Me nuanom adɔfo, monhunu yei sɛ: Nnipa nyinaa nyɛ ntɛm ntie, nyɛ nyaa nkasa, na wɔnyɛ nyaa mfa abufuo; ɛfiri sɛ onipa abufuo nyɛ Nyankopɔn tenenee mu adeɛ. Enti monyi efi ne bɔne nyinaa nto ntwene, na momfa ɔdwoɔ nnye asɛm a wɔatɛ no mo mu a ɛbɛtumi agye mo kra no.
Na monyɛ asɛm no yɛfoɔ, na monnyɛ atiefoɔ nko ara nnaadaa mo ho. Na sɛ obi yɛ asɛm no tiefoɔ na ɔnyɛ ɔyɛfoɔ a, ɔte sɛ onipa a ɔhwɛ n’anim suban ahwehwɛ mu. Na ɔhwɛ ne ho na ɔkɔ, na ntɛm ara na ne werɛ afiri su ko a ɔkura. Na deɛ ɔkoto hwɛ adehyedie mmara a ɛdi mu no mu, na ɔtena mu, na ɔnyɛ otiefoɔ werɛfirifoɔ, na mmom ɔyɛ adwuma no yɛfoɔ no, onii no na wɔbɛhyira no n’adeyɛ no mu.
Sɛ obi susu sɛ ɔyɛ onyamesomni, na wanto ne tɛkyerɛma nnareka, na mmom ɔdaadaa n’akoma a, saa onipa yi nyamesom yɛ ɔkwa. Onyamesom a ɛho teɛ na ɛho nni fi wɔ Agya Nyankopɔn anim ne sɛ obi kɔhwɛ nnyanka ne akunafoɔ wɔ wɔn ahohiahia mu, na ɔyi ne ho firi wiase nkekaeɛ mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
